notes: Total 15 = medium, at/above the max competency floor (medium). The task chains three distinct competencies: reading the legacy auth source and recognising that the login query is spliced with + (string concatenation of user input) for the audit; authoring the hardened /app/app.py render path so the running server keeps its Flask/version identity while binding every supplied payload class as data (never evaluating {{...}}/<%= %>/${}/<?php?>/{% %} via any engine) and tolerating malformed bodies; and driving the provided spreadsheet REST mock to create a nested named spreadsheet+worksheet, record the returned ids, and stay idempotent on re-run. Difficulty comes from interlocking those stages (source audit -> fixed app -> regression harness -> verified resources), from designing a regression checker that both proves non-evaluation across payload classes and preserves the framework banner, and from generalising to hidden payload classes, unicode/special-char spreadsheet names and malformed creates handled cleanly.
